summary: 8 core requirement(s) uncovered by any task

uncovered.text: No moderation/report/mute/remove tooling in v1; this limitation is stated plainly in onboarding/help copy.
No UI implies identity verification or background-check vetting; any trust indicator is labeled honestly as self-reported/peer-vouched.
Matching/visibility is restricted to pre-established trust-graph/pod membership; there is no open stranger/proximity matching.
The entire build is one native SwiftUI app in a single Xcode project — no portfolio split, no sibling apps.

Distinctive visual design implemented via one tokenized Theme.swift file (type/spacing/color), referenced everywhere with zero hardcoded font/spacing/color literals elsewhere, and full dark-mode semantic coverage verified on every core screen in both appearances.

The free tier includes every core relay action (post/accept/release/complete/withdraw and the resulting receipt) fully and forever for at least one pod; nothing in the state machine is gated behind payment.

The literal two-phone side-by-side acceptance demo passes: two real seeded accounts on two real devices, one shows confirmed and the other shows 'already covered by [name]' within a second or two, zero chat, zero manual reconciliation.
Mutual-exclusion invariants for withdraw vs release, and pod-membership checks, are enforced as state-machine/server invariants, not merely UI conventions that could be bypassed by direct API calls.
